Cuisine.description: Fixed list; every recipe has exactly one. "other" covers anything not listed.
Cuisine.title: Cuisine

DietaryLabel.description: Fixed list used for filtering. A recipe has zero or more.
DietaryLabel.title: DietaryLabel

IngredientIn.description: POST /api/ingredients: add an ingredient to the dropdown (or get the existing one).
IngredientIn.title: IngredientIn

IngredientSuggestion.description: ASSUMPTION (1): GET /api/ingredients?q= returns matching ingredient names for the form.
IngredientSuggestion.title: IngredientSuggestion

MealType.description: What a recipe suits. A recipe has one or more; used as a filter (the plan has no fixed slots).
MealType.title: MealType

OptionsOut.description: GET /api/options: the fixed lists, typed as enums so clients get exact values.
OptionsOut.title: OptionsOut

PlaceOut.description: GET /api/places (nearby, sorted by distance) and GET /api/places/{id}.
PlaceOut.title: PlaceOut

PlaceType.description: Kinds of place that share free meals (Free meals nearby).
PlaceType.title: PlaceType

PlanDaysOut.description: GET /api/plan/days?month=YYYY-MM: days with meals, for the calendar dots.
PlanDaysOut.title: PlanDaysOut

PlanEntryCreate.description:
POST /api/plan/entries. The meal goes last on that day.

Give exactly one of recipeId or placeMealId. A place meal can only go on its weekday.
PlanEntryCreate.title: PlanEntryCreate

PlanEntryOut.description: A planned meal: either a recipe (kind "recipe") or a free meal from a place (kind "free_meal").
PlanEntryOut.title: PlanEntryOut

PlanEntryUpdate.description: PATCH /api/plan/entries/{id}: change servings, swap recipe, move day or reorder.
PlanEntryUpdate.title: PlanEntryUpdate

PlanPlaceMealOut.description: A free meal from a place, as shown in the week plan.
PlanPlaceMealOut.title: PlanPlaceMealOut

RecipeDetail.description: GET /api/recipes/{id}?servings=N. Quantities are scaled when servings is given.
RecipeDetail.title: RecipeDetail

RecipePage.description: GET /api/recipes: one page of results. A page past the end has no items but the right totals.
RecipePage.title: RecipePage

RecipeUsageOut.description: ASSUMPTION (3): GET /api/recipes/{id}/usage -> {"upcomingMeals": N} for the delete confirmation.
RecipeUsageOut.title: RecipeUsageOut

TagIn.description: POST /api/tags (the recipe form can also send new tag names directly).
TagIn.title: TagIn

WeekPlanOut.description: GET /api/plan?week=YYYY-MM-DD (any date in the week; defaults to this week).
WeekPlanOut.title: WeekPlanOut
